message: 肩を並べる第一歩
The current time is 11:00.
Maybe I was getting ahead of myself. I ended up arriving earlier than I thought.
Incidentally, we agreed to meet at 13:00.
Being late is the one thing that can't be forgiven. After all, I'm going on a date with Ria-senpai.
Well, part of it is also that I didn't want Paqy teasing me about my outfit, so I wanted to leave while she was still asleep.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, arriving two hours early might be overdoing it a bit...」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh... S-Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai?!」
Ria-senpai looks back and forth between my face and her own wrist.

name: Ria
message: 「W-W-Wrong wrist.」
Flustered, she checks the time on her cell phone.

name: Ria
message: 「Isn't it... um, still early?」
My face feels like it's going to erupt from embarrassment.

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're early yourself, Senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehh?! I-I'm... um... well...」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, right! I thought I'd do a little shopping before coming here~ Just kidding\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「If you add a punchline like that, it gives away that you're lying.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm not lying!!」

name: Ria
message: 「I can't possibly say I left early because I didn't want my big sister teasing me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well... it's better than being late, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah, it is♪」
We stare at each other in silence.
It had been pushed to the back of my mind by our shocking meetup, but this is the first time I've seen Ria-senpai in casual clothes.
Her usual uniform is one thing, but why does she go out of her way to choose outfits that accentuate her chest like this?
Just looking at Ria-senpai is making my heart pound.

name: Ria
message: 「Does this... look weird?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, that's not true at all! It looks super good on you!!」

name: Ria
message: 「You don't have to insist so hard\s02　Still... thank you」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure you'd look great in anything you wear, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, you don't need to flatter me. My big sister actually picked this out for me.」
Picturing Helena-san's smug grin, I pump my fist in my heart.

name: Ria
message: 「It's not time to meet up yet, so... what should we do?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Alright, let's get going!」
It was an unexpected turn of events, yet I couldn't be luckier. After all, it means I get to spend even more time with Senpai.

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, hello~~ Thanks so much for yesterday♪」

name: Synn
message: 「If there's ever anything else, please don't hesitate to let us know」
We exchange greetings with the shopkeepers.

name: Ria
message: 「Ever since KiraFes ended, people started calling out to me right away」

name: Synn
message: 「There are quite a few Ryuusei Academy students around here, too. Who knew you'd fit right in this quickly」

name: Ria
message: 「The KiraFes effect is super effective♪」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh hey. Hello there~」

name: Ria
message: 「Takahashi-san... right? Thanks for yesterday」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, it was nothing at all~」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you out shopping, Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm taking home some cake from Chocolat l'Or~」
Saying that, she shows off an expensive-looking box.

name: Ria
message: 「If you swing it around too much, it'll fall apart」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It'll be totally fine~」

name: Synn
message: 「So you like cake too, huh, Sacchin」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Every girl loves cake~ Right, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah♪」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Still, try to keep this a secret from Nana-chan, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because if we tell her, she'll eat it all.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yep, yep. I'll keep it a secret for you too~」

name: Synn
message: 「Keep what a secret?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nothing at all~ See ya!」
She skips away happily.

name: Ria
message: 「Oh no, the cake's going to get ruined... She's going to be disappointed when she eats it...」

name: Synn
message: 「You could say that's part of Sacchin's charm.」
Still, Chocolat l'Or, huh... If I remember right, the manager is a young woman named Fuyuka Anenokouji.
It seems like Nanaka was in her care quite a bit during KiraFes, too.

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, mind if we peek inside Chocolat for a bit?」
No matter how many times I see it, just the exterior makes me shrink back--a world completely different from my own lies here.
After suggesting we go in myself, getting cold feet isn't an option. It'd be one thing if I were alone, but Ria-senpai is right beside me.
I stepped inside with determination.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Welcome. Welcome to Chocolat l'Or!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hello~~」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Well, well, if it isn't the Student Council President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, well... I happened to be in the neighborhood, so I thought I'd say hello...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Please, don't worry about such formalities. Come, right this way.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no, I really just came to say hello.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Don't say that.」
We were forcefully guided to a table.

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, um, today isn't for Student Council business!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「I'm honored that you would grace us with a visit even in your private time♪ Please wait just a moment.」
Saying that, the manager of Chocolat headed into the back.

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...\s02 Did we just get ourselves into a big mess?」

name: Synn
message: 「Haa... My heart's pounding.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, sorry! I... haven't really been to a place like this before, so I just end up getting nervous...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph~~ Is that so~~」

name: Synn
message: 「You're amazing, Senpai. You seem pretty used to places like this」

name: Ria
message: 「N-Not really, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Anyway! Try not to fidget so much, or you'll look uncool」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes, ma'am!」
I should straighten my back and pull myself together.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Thank you for waiting♪」
The manager places a white plate on the table for us.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「First, this here is our Banane Chocolat」

name: Synn
message: 「Oooh~~!」
Resting elegantly on the plate was what appeared to be a chocolate cake unlike anything I'd ever seen.

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!!」
This wasn't the time to have stars in my eyes. I needed to clarify why things were unfolding like this.

name: Synn
message: 「What is the meaning of this... I get it! This is a tasting for a new cake, isn't it」

name: Ria
message: 「This isn't the Wagashi Club, you know\s02」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Yes. Unfortunately, it isn't a new item, but I simply wanted you both to enjoy one of our shop's most popular treats」

name: Synn
message: 「Could that mean...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~ Doesn't that mean... it's on the house?」

name: Synn
message: 「What?! But that's not why I came here at all...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Please don't worry about the bill. Think of it as a token of my gratitude」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... Are you sure?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Thanks to the two of you, look at how many more customers we have than usual!」
Between the seating area and the front of the display case, business seems to be booming.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it is Sunday, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, that's not the time to play the fool\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, so I can really eat this cake!?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Yes, of course.」
So this is what they call the perks of being Student Council President~~.

name: Ria
message: 「After all, she's being so generous♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Ufufu. Please take your time and enjoy our shop's sweets♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa...」

name: Ria
message: 「What a cute cake~\s04」
They say good things fall right into your lap, and this is certainly a welcome stroke of luck.

name: Ria
message: 「Here, say ahh~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」
While I was busy staring, Ria-senpai had already held out a fork to me.

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, it's gonna fall, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Okay!」

name: Ria
message: 「You don't need to lean forward. I'll bring it right to your mouth.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well... I just always end up doing this out of habit.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh~? So you get fed 'ahh~' often enough for it to become a habit?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!? No! It's not like that--」

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be that Nanaka-chan always does it for you!?」

name: Synn
message: 「As if Nanaka would ever do that!」

name: Ria
message: 「I see... Then, your mom?」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, that's not it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. What a spoiled little boy\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Guhhh\s03」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go, dig in♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaah. Nom, nom...」
Sweetness and bitterness spread throughout my mouth. If I were to put this into words--

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, I'm glad you like it」

name: Synn
message: 「Then next up is your turn, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I don't need to do it~~\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not fair after making only me do it」

name: Ria
message: 「No means no! Getting fed like that is a privilege reserved for the Student Council President!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it works?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem. Indeed it is」

name: Synn
message: 「Then as the former Student Council President, you're eligible too, Ria-senpai. So, say ahh」

name: Ria
message: 「Like I said, I'm really fine~~\s03」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「How do you find them? Our shop's prized sweets」

name: Ria
message: 「Aaah, chomp. Nom, nom」
Whoa, she ate it in a flash before getting caught.

name: Ria
message: 「Yes, it possessed a most sweet and refined flavor」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Oh my, how wonderful♪ Now then, what about you, Mr. Student Council President...」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see...」
I seriously contemplate the taste. For once, it might be less rude if I expressed it with words other than 'Delicious!'
Alright, decided!

name: Synn
message: 「If I were to compare it to something, it gave me the exact same thrill as 'taking a huge bite right out of a whole chocolate bar'」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Our shop's chocolate... is like a... chocolate bar... you say...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes! It brought back the pure joy of being told I didn't have to save the foil wrapper!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Hey, Mr. Student Council President!? Isn't there a limit to how rude you can be!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehh!? Why!?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Let me make this clear. Our Anegakoji Group is a long-established chocolate maker」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「We are obsessively particular about both our ingredients and our methods, dedicating ourselves day and night to research and training so we can delight countless customers!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y―Yes... That's why I said it's delicious―」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「So why on earth would you compare it to a cheap chocolate bar!」

name: Ria
message: 「N-Now, now. Please calm down」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Chocolate is a luxury item, so to speak. Do you even understand the passion and love poured into it when you say things like that!?」

name: Synn
message: 「To me, even a chocolate bar is a luxury item... No, an extravagance」

name: Synn
message: 「Chomping into a whole chocolate bar is a huge splurge that happens maybe once a year for me, if that...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「H-How pitiful...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyway, what I mean is that to me, it's a food as luxurious as a whole chocolate bar」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「I-It's a bit hard to wrap my head around, but... you weren't trying to insult it, then」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course not! Who would ever make fun of a cake this delicious!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone's sense of taste is different, after all」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「I'm sorry. I went too far too」

name: Synn
message: 「No... I'm sorry I could only phrase it in a way that caused a misunderstanding」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「In that case, let's see... From now on, you can use our chocolate as your comparison instead」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「That way, you'll bring up Chocola's chocolates instead of a plain chocolate bar, right」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「With that settled... Excuse me! Please bring a full course for this customer here」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh... are you sure!?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Hehe. Make sure you etch the flavor of the chocolat deeply into your heart, alright?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Thank you very much!」

name: Ria
message: 「Whoa, there's so much of it, all this...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「How is the taste?」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Ria
message: 「Even then, it's still 'delicious,' huh\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew~~. That was delicious~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe. What a glutton you are」

name: Synn
message: 「You're one to talk, Ria-senpai, you ate every last bite yourself」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, she went out of her way to treat us, after all~」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if this makes me a bit more of a gourmet now...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~~. Maybe we won't know unless we eat a little more?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha」

name: Ria
message: 「Wha!? Why are you laughing~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because you're an even bigger glutton than I am, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「I told you I'm not!」
Senpai lightly pats my back over and over.
It feels weirdly comforting.

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks for inviting me out today」

name: Synn
message: 「No, not at all. Everything ended up kind of spur-of-the-moment, anyway」

name: Ria
message: 「Having unexpected things happen makes it more thrilling and fun, doesn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, true」

name: Ria
message: 「The date was super fun」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「If a date is this much fun, I'd love to go even without using a stamp~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, does that mean...」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah♪ Let's go again」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yes!」
Granting any wish I asked for.
I had thought that if I wanted to go on a date with Ria-senpai, I wouldn't be able to make it happen unless I used something like that as an excuse.
Yet here we are, able to make plans for next time just like this.
Just thinking about that makes my heart leap.
Bathed in the warm glow of the setting sun, Ria-senpai and I smiled at each other.
Kuu~~! A sparkling school life really is the best.

name: Synn
message: 「Should we go to Chocolat l'Or again next time?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, I might pass on chocolate for a while\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Wahahahaha」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey--! Don't laugh--!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm hooome~~♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, welcome back」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm hooome~~♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Welcome back」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm hooome~~!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Agh, you're too loud, seriously!」

name: Synn
message: 「Man~~, that was fun」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is that so, is that so. Dunno who you were with, but good for you」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean who, it was Ria-senpai」

name: Paqy
message: 「What, just Ria-chan? Jeez, she's no big deal――」

name: Paqy
message: 「Like hell I'd believe that, you gotta be kidding me--!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's true」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Spouting jokes to deceive the great me, just as expected of the Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like you left your trusting heart behind in your main body」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hold on... *sniff sniff*. This is Ria-chan's scent! N-no way... Could it really be...」

name: Synn
message: 「Expected nothing less from a panda」

name: Paqy
message: 「J-just hypothetically, okay? Let's say, hypothetically, that the Demon Lord went on a date with Ria-chan」

name: Paqy
message: 「Does that mean, y'know!? You held hands, or linked arms, and got into a situation where the tips of those voluptuous boobs were poking right up against you!?」
Come to think of it, even though it was a date, it feels like there was actually less physical contact than usual…….

name: Paqy
message: 「Aha~ I see how it is. You made zero progress, didn't you」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't care, it's fine!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, at that rate, you don't stand a chance」

name: Synn
message: 「W-what did you say!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe…… Someday I'll get Ria-chan to hug me too, and have her rest her boobs right on top of my head」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't look at Ria-senpai with such perverted eyes!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch. Quit acting like such a goody-two-shoes」

name: Synn
message: 「So Paqy's a bad boy, huh. Well then, no dinner for you tonight」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「I ate a ton of delicious chocolate, so I'm not really that hungry」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, you're kidding me, right」

name: Synn
message: 「Good night～～」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm begging you, please make dinner! Lord Synn!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Good grief, you're hopeless……」

name: Paqy
message: 「Munch, munch…… Delicious!」
